title: Polish the standings page on phone
request: the standings page on my phone

criteria.text: Podium team names show up to 2 lines and have a title, so teams with a shared prefix are told apart at 390px
criteria.evidence: QA measured at 360/390: podium name 2 lines, 30px tall, title = full name. Shots .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-the-standings-pag/before/phone-stats.png vs .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-the-standings-pag/after/phone-stats.png

criteria.text: Selected Compact/Detailed item is visually distinct from keyboard focus (focus ring stays, selected uses fill only)
criteria.evidence: QA measured: selected+unfocused has fill, no ring; selected+focused shows 2px+2px ring. .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-the-standings-pag/after/phone-stats.png

criteria.text: Compact-row team link is at least 44px tall
criteria.evidence: QA measured compact links: 44, 68.5, 44, 68.5 px at 360; 44, 51, 44, 51 at 390 (before 33.5 single-line)

criteria.text: Division/All and Compact/Detailed toggle items are at least 44px tall and wide
criteria.evidence: QA measured toggles 99.2x44, 63x44, 72.1x44, 67.2x44 (before 40 tall). Desktop shot unchanged: .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-the-standings-pag/after/desktop-stats.png

criteria.text: Empty-state text no longer mentions a division control that is not on that screen
criteria.evidence: Seen in .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-the-standings-pag/after-empty/phone-stats.png: 'There are no teams to show right now.' / 'No teams have been added yet.'; test StatsContainer 6/6 pass

criteria.text: No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390px, touched components' tests pass
criteria.evidence: All 6 required checks pass at HEAD (typecheck, lint, unit 565s, build, knip, integrity). QA measured no sideways scroll at 360/390, 0 console errors with the mock run.

interventions.why: Asked Doug how to get data for screenshots; answer: fake test data (mock)

notes.text: Left alone on purpose: power-score light-theme contrast (shared by ~10 views, needs Doug), chart dead space, error-state height, decorative dot. Human choice: fake-data screenshots.
Observation, not fixed: at 1280px the first division table's Trend header is clipped at the right edge (same in before and after shots; may come from the long fake names).
